appearances.title: Models: GPT 6.2 Astra Preview Begins Rolling Out to Kiro Enterprise
appearances.summary: GPT 6.2 Astra is beginning to roll out in Preview across Kiro clients for Kiro Enterprise organizations. It is OpenAI's frontier model for complex, multistep projects, such as implementing and testing changes in existing codebases. It has a 1M context window and a 7.2x credit multiplier, which rises to 14.4x for requests over 272K tokens. Inference runs only in the US geography.
